purpose: Teach: 三角形/水晶/ルネサンス/ナベ/円盤/ボールペン/鳥居/フルート

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きで三角形を上手に描けたわね
lines.en: Sho, you drew that triangle so nicely.
lines.style: Warm affirmation, eyes bright with genuine delight. Soft landing on the praise—not overdone. The tone of a mother noticing a small thing that matters to her child.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんから水晶のお守りもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma gave me a crystal charm.
lines.style: Bright announcement, eager to share. Quick tempo, words tumbling forward. Seeking immediate reaction—the urgency of a child who wants to know his news landed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがルネサンス絵画のご本を読んでらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Your father's reading a book about Renaissance paintings, you know.
lines.style: Conversational aside, gentle observation. Calm, almost speaking aloud something she's noticed. Slight warmth—she's sharing a small detail about his day with affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんの大きなナベでおでん食べたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat oden in Grandma's big pot.
lines.style: Direct request, but softer than urgent. Warm nostalgia in the wanting—he's imagining the scene. Simple, genuine longing without whining.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがレコードの円盤を整理してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Your father's organizing his record collection at the moment.
lines.style: Another quiet observation, almost to herself. Steady, patient tone. The rhythm of domestic life she's describing—no judgment, just noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと一緒のボールペン欲しい
lines.en: Mom, I want the same ballpoint pen as Dad has.
lines.style: Simple, clear want. Not demanding—just stating what he desires. Soft certainty in his voice. The kind of small admission a child makes to his mother.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと初詣で鳥居をくぐりましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go visit the shrine with your father for New Year's, hmm?
lines.style: Tender invitation, gentle lilt at the end. Warm anticipation in her voice. The 'hmm?' is conspiratorial—inviting him into something nice they'll do together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんがフルート教えてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me how to play the flute.
lines.style: Quiet pride, eyes bright. Words careful, almost reverent—he's sharing something significant he did with his father. Small smile underneath the words.
